description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and configurations related to integrating Azure Table reminders into Orleans. It includes extension methods for configuring services and silos, as well as classes for managing Azure Table storage options and a reminder table implementation.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Storage operations related to reminders, including table client options and storage policies.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Contains policy options for Azure Storage, such as timeouts and retry counts.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Specific options for Azure Table-based reminder storage, including default table name.

classes.name: AzureBasedReminderTable
classes.description: Implementation of IReminderTable for Azure Table storage, managing reading, writing, and testing reminder entries.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Azure Table Reminder Service in Orleans, 지원 with connection string or options.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Obsolete methods to configure the TableServiceClient directly in AzureStorageOperationOptions.
